integrity: A compatible ternary-adic measure and two sharp index isometries provide the infinite proof; a standalone exact modular checker is supplementary, not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Classical ordered Bell numbers at p=3 only; no other primes or general Fubini parameters. Published modulo-nine congruence and eventual periods are prior results, not re-claimed. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: The complete ternary residue image and fibers of the ordered Bell numbers
